title: Announcement
message:
Hey guys!

MusicOS Version 2.0.4 is coming very soon!

Get ready for an exciting update featuring:

• Beautiful new animations
• A completely refreshed UI design
• Smoother and more fluid experience
• Improved visuals and overall performance

I'm working hard on this update all by myself to make MusicOS even better for you.

Your support means a lot to me.

Stay tuned. Something exciting is coming!

— Developer of MusicOS
